narrative.overview:
A shop counter is a platform: things arrive, get called out, and leave on time. SmartLedger takes Indian Railways signage and timetable tradition for its type, palette, density and one move only. A cool paper-white ground carries a railway-blue shell, hairline rules, tabular columns of rupees, and go/stop signal colours that mean exactly that. The microphone is the one yellow signal on the board.

The system is calm and dense where money is shown and loud only where an action or a warning needs to be. Components are standard shadcn/ui (Radix) on Tailwind, re-skinned entirely through tokens in src/index.css. Light is the platform by day; dark is the night platform, a blue-black ground where yellow takes over as the primary fill.

It rejects the generic fintech dashboard: white card walls, purple or blue gradients, a hero-metric grid.
keyCharacteristics: Railway blue shell and primary; signal yellow reserved for the mic and the selected state.
Bilingual sign pairs (English primary, Hindi secondary) on nav items and page titles.
Tabular numerals set globally; every figure aligns in columns.
Departure-board reveal: parsed voice lines post row by row.
Light and dark themes with the same roles; Hindi is first-class.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Signal Yellow means "voice" or "you are here". It never decorates a card, badge, chart or heading.

rules.name: The Go/Stop Rule
rules.body: Green means money in or healthy; red means stop or low. Never swap them for branding.

rules.name: The Paired Surface Rule
rules.body: Every status colour is used as text/solid plus its soft fill; never raw alpha tints.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is set on body; money and quantities always align in columns. Currency is formatted en-IN with the rupee.

rules.name: The Sign Pair Rule
rules.body: A bilingual label is English at full size over (or beside) Hindi at 0.8em, normal weight, 75% opacity, tagged lang="hi". Hindi is a translation of the existing label, never new copy.

rules.name: The Flat Platform Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow marks something that floats above the page (mic, menu, dialog), never a card.

dos: Do use the token roles (bg-background, text-muted-foreground, bg-signal, text-success, soft fills) rather than raw hex.
Do pair every nav item and page title in English with a Hindi translation (Insights / आज का हाल, Ledger / खाता, Stock / माल, Price Sheet / भाव, Settings / सेटिंग).
Do keep touch targets at or above 44px on mobile and keep focus rings visible in both themes.
Do let money be the largest type on a screen and align it with tabular numerals.
Do make every new motion honour prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't spend Signal Yellow on anything but voice and the selected state.
Don't use purple or blue gradients, white card grids around a hero metric, or other generic fintech dashboard devices.
Don't add shadows to cards, or introduce radii outside the 4/6/8/12px scale.
Don't set Hindi in a different weight, face or colour from its English pair, or add Hindi copy that is not a translation of an existing label.
Don't put a quantity, price or total in proportional figures.
